name: Counter → Increment
description: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) adds a number to the counter. The number defaults to `1` and can be negative to count down.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the counter. Must be specified if more than one counter is configured.

config_entries.label: Value
config_entries.description: The amount to add. Defaults to `1`. Must be within the range of a signed 64-bit integer. If the result goes past the largest or smallest 64-bit value, it wraps around.
